title: Median sold prices by local authority and region, England and Wales

Region lookup: Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v.3.0.
method: Category A (standard price paid) sales only, by transfer date, one row per local authority or region, period (calendar year or calendar quarter) and split (a split is one grouping at a time: all sales, one property type, one tenure, or new-build or existing; they are not combined; quarters have all sales and the four property types only). Medians and quartiles (inclusive method) in whole pounds, nominal and not adjusted for inflation; null when a period has fewer than 5 sales (a quality threshold: every sale is already published by HM Land Registry). Rows with no sales are left out. Only complete periods are shown; the latest period is as at the month the file was built, and sales registered later are added when the file is next rebuilt (when a new quarter has ended or the postcode release changes). Authorities are the current authorities of the ONS Postcode Directory release named in the file, applied back to 1995: a sale counts in the authority its postcode is in today, not the authority it was in at the time. Sales whose postcode could not be placed in an authority are counted in no area. Regions are the English regions of the ONS lookup; Wales is one area. England and Wales only. Not an index: the mix of homes sold changes from period to period.
